results.title: Kiriko's Baton: YELL
results.overview: Years after graduating from high school, music journalist Shō Kitamura is assigned to write about his former teacher, Kiriko Harada, a legendary choir instructor known for inspiring troubled students with her remarkable conducting and unwavering belief in them. But Kiriko has retired and mysteriously disappeared. As Shō reunites with former choir classmates and retraces their memories of their beloved teacher, he begins to uncover the story behind her disappearance and the profound impact she had on their lives. Inspired by Ikimonogakari’s hit song “YELL,” Echoes of Kiriko is a heartfelt drama about music, friendship, hope, and the enduring bond between a teacher and her students.

results.title: F(r)iction
results.overview: Decades after a shocking serial murder case involving the swapping of spouses, a stage production based on the real-life crimes is being prepared. Inexperienced actor Tada is cast in the lead role, but as he becomes increasingly consumed by the character and begins to blur the line between fiction and reality, his obsession draws the play's cast and crew into his increasingly disturbing delusions. As opening night approaches, the boundary between truth and fiction collapses, leaving everyone to question what is real and what is imagined.

results.title: The Mega Cut
results.overview: Imagine walking into a theater to watch a film made up entirely of other films. No story to follow. No main character. Just seventy-five minutes of pure movie magic… every jaw-dropping moment, gut-punch line, iconic quote you half-remember, all expertly edited together into one wild ride.

results.title: Cemeuble
results.overview: The limitation of using a single frame as the rhythmic element of the film.  The journey of a shape in a geometric landscape. Telling another story using material found, the account of a rather chaotic journey. Fragments of beginnings, collages of frames, films found, all of which is put on a 35mm film. The images echo the crackling of magnetic tapes.  The images of a tank are shot to a strange rhythm, generated by a repetitive hammering sound. Weaves of a fragmented narrative of a collective history.  Music and images mixed together in a dance which links the sky to the earth and the earth to the sky. The overlapping of images, found and stuck, link us to a still vibrant history.
